title: maint.event.v1{kind=backup_completed}
description: Phase 8 §8.3 — emitted by maint.backup.v1 once the dump → restore-verify → prune state machine finishes (or aborts). Notification only.

verify_summary.description: Per-table row counts + schema_migrations max version when outcome=ok.

verify_mode.description: Restore-verify mode that ran (ROADMAP §8.3 escape hatch).

verified.description: True iff outcome=ok (i.e. restore-verify produced a non-empty verify_summary). dry_run runs report false so dashboards never count a dry-run as a verified backup.

dump_retention.description: GFS-light retention sweep that ran after a successful prune (omitted on non-ok outcomes). Reports the partition of on-disk dump-window dirs.

quarantined_dir.description: On verify_failed, the renamed `<window>.failed/` dir; null when no on-disk dump existed.
